scope: Known EraEdu application schema, grants, function bodies, metadata inventory, aggregate integrity, and public signed-out API checks

checks.check_name: active teacher exams linked to unpublished courses
checks.detail: May be intentional drafts. Students cannot start until the selected course is published and they enroll; no automatic publishing

checks.check_name: cached violation count differs from persisted events
checks.detail: Investigate; do not overwrite event history with browser counters

checks.check_name: active teacher attempts without timing snapshot
checks.detail: 027 requires an exam-free migration window; do not fabricate fresh deadlines

checks.check_name: teacher attempts with missing exam
checks.detail: Teacher attempts use teacher_quizzes, not quizzes

checks.check_name: account status unknown
checks.detail: Never assume NULL means active; review 029 prerequisites

checks.check_name: active quiz codes with a different course than their teacher exam
checks.detail: Review intended scope after course changes; do not silently transfer access or enrollment

checks.check_name: active topic attempts without question snapshot
checks.detail: 022; investigate without resetting the assessment

checks.check_name: assigned bank questions with missing topic
checks.detail: Unassigned questions are permitted; only broken non-null references counted

checks.check_name: attempts with missing student
checks.detail: Do not erase assessment history

checks.check_name: completed attempts with impossible score bounds
checks.detail: A bounded score alone does not prove correct grading

checks.check_name: course exam manager mismatch
checks.detail: 024 transfers management while preserving original authorship/history

checks.check_name: courses over capacity
checks.detail: Investigate history and capacity changes; do not remove students automatically

checks.check_name: duplicate active attempts per model
checks.detail: Never delete student work to make a unique index succeed

checks.check_name: duplicate enrollments
checks.detail: Review records before applying/repairing 023 uniqueness

checks.check_name: duplicate integrity event identities
checks.detail: 019; NULL IDs are legacy events, not invented duplicates

checks.check_name: duplicate normalized account emails
checks.detail: Review privately; do not delete or merge accounts automatically

checks.check_name: duplicate organization memberships
checks.detail: One seat per (organization,user)

checks.check_name: enrollments with missing student or course
checks.detail: Preserve records for reviewed repair

checks.check_name: feedback ownership/completion mismatch
checks.detail: 009; review historical rows, never bypass ownership

checks.check_name: integrity events with missing attempt or mismatched student
checks.detail: Persisted events are authoritative; review attribution

checks.check_name: invalid course capacity
checks.detail: NULL is unlimited; supplied limits must be positive

checks.check_name: invalid exam security settings
checks.detail: Monitoring must be explicit; threshold must be between 1 and 100

checks.check_name: memberships with missing organization or user
checks.detail: Review institution boundaries

checks.check_name: multiple-choice bank questions with invalid options or correct index
checks.detail: Old writes may have lost index zero. Ask the author to review; never guess an answer, rewrite historical snapshots or regrade automatically.

checks.check_name: organizations over seat capacity
checks.detail: Every membership row, including owner/admin, consumes one seat

checks.check_name: organizations with invalid capacity
checks.detail: Seat limit must be between 1 and 10000

checks.check_name: password-reset challenge fields expired over 24 hours
checks.detail: Temporary-field cleanup candidate only; preserve accounts, passwords and current reset links. No cleanup is performed.

checks.check_name: payment records with invalid state or amount
checks.detail: No provider calls or entitlement changes are made by this report

checks.check_name: payment records with missing owner or institution
checks.detail: NULL organization_id is a supported legacy personal payment

checks.check_name: quiz codes without a teacher-exam reference
checks.detail: 030 must refuse these rows; review legacy topic codes without deleting or relinking them

checks.check_name: student OTP challenge fields expired over 24 hours
checks.detail: Temporary-field cleanup candidate only; preserve accounts and active verification challenges. No cleanup is performed.

checks.check_name: teacher exams with missing owner or assigned course
checks.detail: Standalone exams can have NULL course_id

checks.check_name: topic attempts with missing or mismatched exam/topic
checks.detail: Topic attempts intentionally use quizzes and topics

checks.check_name: topics with missing course
checks.detail: Review references; do not delete material

checks.check_name: unsupported account role
checks.detail: Review legacy roles explicitly; do not rewrite roles just to pass

legacyStripeTable.decision: Retained; RLS with no policies and no browser bypass denies row access. Ownership review required before changing this legacy table.

publicApi.scope: public HTTP contracts and signed-out boundaries; no authenticated business workflows
